ambiguities.kbar_k2bar_rows: the as-of mean of e~/e (T1) and e2/e (T2) uses played roster rows with >= 5 prior appearances in the data (a proxy of 'A0 rows', available for 2022 too) dated strictly earlier; 1.0 until KBAR_MIN_ROWS exist. T2's mean can only use test-season (out-of-fold) predictions, so it stays 1.0 longer.
ambiguities.abs_elo_margin: |as-of Elo margin| comes from the stored lower-tail components (row_abs_margin) per team-game; NaN for team-games with no component row (all 2022); LightGBM takes NaN
ambiguities.n_out_rot: number of OUT-flagged players among those with >= 15 minutes per appearance in the previous 10 games (self-defined; production's own n_out_rot is not exported for DNP rows)
ambiguities.oracles: O1 = T1 with the realised roster minutes as the budget; O2 = realised minutes / max(e, 0.5) normalised by its as-of mean, both inside the [0.8, 1.25] clip
ambiguities.placebo_P2: every T2 feature column is permuted jointly within team-season in training and test rows; the ratio denominator e stays the real one
ambiguities.shuffled_label: T2 share model refit with training shares permuted within each block's training set (seed 0); the same stat-independent fit scores every stat
ambiguities.consistency_kappa: Dirichlet kappa by method of moments from the 2023 out-of-fold T2 shares, used for 2024 draws only; descriptive
ambiguities.decision_p: P(over) = share of integer quantiles >= ceil(line) of each arm's grid; A0's comparator uses the mixture grid, not the stored p_model
